meta.title: busspotburgas – Burgasbus spotters
meta.description: Photos of every bus in Burgas by fleet number, owners, ratings, points and live sightings.

footer.tagline: A community site for Burgasbus spotters. No ads.

home.title: Every bus in Burgas. One photo at a time.
home.lead: Shoot, upload and collect every vehicle of the city's public transport. Pick your own bus, earn points and see live sightings around town.
home.stageNote: The site is being built in stages. Now: the foundation. Next up: profiles, photos and Live.
home.noPhotos: No approved photos yet. Upload the first one!

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.lead: Every Burgasbus vehicle. No photo yet? Be the first!
fleet.dbMissing: The database is not connected yet. Add the Supabase keys (see README).

offline: You're offline – showing the saved version.

auth.registerLead: Browsing is free. A profile is needed for uploads, ratings, comments and Live.
auth.checkLead: We sent you a confirmation link. Click it to continue setting up your profile. Can't see it? Check Spam or Promotions.
auth.forgotLead: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password. The link is valid for 1 hour.
auth.forgotSent: If a profile with this email exists, the link is on its way.
auth.mfaLead: Open Google Authenticator and enter the 6-digit code for busspotburgas.

onboarding.consentLead: Confirm you are 14+ and agree to the terms.
onboarding.profileLead: How should other spotters see you? A nickname or your name.
onboarding.holdersLead: Pick your own vehicle of this model. You can take several, or choose "None". Change any time.
onboarding.takenHint: Taken vehicles have an owner. Co-owner invites are coming soon.
onboarding.hasPartners: This vehicle has co-owners – you can't leave it right now.

tour.title: Upload photos
tour.text: Shoot Burgasbus vehicles and upload them with the fleet number and line. The admin approves every photo.

tour.title: Owners and co-owners
tour.text: Your buses are on your profile. If someone wants your bus, you decide if they become a co-owner.

tour.title: Points and ranks
tour.text: +10 pts per approved photo, +20 for the first photo of a vehicle. From Rookie to Legend.

tour.title: Live sightings
tour.text: Spotted a bus? Tap "I saw a bus" and everyone sees it on the map.

me.title: My profile
me.emailUnconfirmed: Your email is not confirmed – you can't upload photos yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dataLead: Download everything the site stores about you (GDPR).
settings.deleteLead: Your profile and buses are deleted forever. Photos stay with the author "Former spotter".

admin.title: Admin
admin.notAdmin: You don't have access to this page.
admin.enrollLead: The admin logs in with password + code. Open Google Authenticator → "+" → "Scan a QR code" and scan it. Then enter the 6 digits.
admin.secretLabel: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
admin.dashboardLead: Approval queues, fleet and spotter management are coming in the next stages.
admin.backupNote: Supabase has no backup codes. Instead: add a second device (second phone or a password manager) and create a second admin account.

legal.draft: Short version. The full text comes before the official launch.

upload.title: Upload a photo
upload.lead: 4 quick steps. The admin approves every photo before it appears.
upload.needConfirm: Confirm your email to upload photos.
upload.chooseHint: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB. GPS data is removed automatically.
upload.facesFound: Faces blurred: {n}. Tap the photo to add or remove a blur.
upload.facesNone: No faces found. If there are any, tap them on the photo to blur them.
upload.cropHint: Move and zoom to pick the frame. The full photo is kept too.
upload.rights: I share the rights to this photo with the site (it may be shown on the site's social media).
upload.donePending: The photo is waiting for the admin's approval. You'll get an email.
upload.duplicateTitle: This photo looks like one already uploaded
upload.faceTap: Tap a face to blur it

errors.type: The photo must be JPG, PNG or WebP.

errors.vehicle: Pick a number from the list.
errors.line: Enter a line (up to 12 characters) or "depot".

errors.upload_invalid: The file is invalid or too large. Try again.
errors.upload_metadata: Hidden data remained in the photo. Try another browser.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email to upload photos.
